snippet.title: Fractured Worlds Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Fractured Worlds is out now on PC (Steam/EGS), Playstation 5 and Nintendo Switch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1879860/Fractured_Worlds/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017408
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fractured-worlds-switch/
https://store.epicgames.com/p/fractured-worlds-9714c5

Fractured Worlds is a dark fantasy action RPG set in the shattered remnants of a ruined reality. Master weighty, precision-based combat, explore diverse realms, and face challenging bosses alone or together with other players. Leave messages, share procedural encounters or dungeons, assist or invade other players and even create NPCs with your build to help or hinder other players while you do something else!
